claim_boundary: The feature set follows an outcome-aware feasibility analysis on this development replay. Nested folds prevent direct study leakage, but the result remains development-selected and can only nominate a gate for a new prospective test.
decision_sequence: Compute outcome-free support features for the frozen retrieved history.
Use the learned gate to decide whether the history-conditioned forecast is supported.
Abstain when the gate is within 0.10 of equal support or the selected forecast abstains.
features: maximum and mean lexical similarity between the target and retrieved environments
count and dispersion of numeric starting-policy measurements
frozen_comparators: retain the starting policy when a native study exposes that option

model.model_selection: Minimize study-macro routed normalized regret across five deterministic study-grouped inner folds; break ties by lower Brier score and then stronger regularization.
model.probability_target: whether retrieved history produces lower panel regret than measurement only

outer_unit: complete held-out study or agentic-coding training decision
scoring: history-benefit Brier score and ROC AUC when both classes are present
prompt, completion, and total inference tokens
status: development contract frozen before the definitive nested gate replay
